title: Player-Level Advanced Stats as Cat44: BPM, PIE, RAPTOR Features
rationale: 2025-2026 research consistently shows player-aggregated features outperform team-aggregated features
Key advantage: player-level data responds to roster changes (trades, injuries) 2-3x faster than team rolling averages
BPM (Box Plus/Minus) is a comprehensive impact metric capturing offense + defense contribution
PIE (Player Impact Estimate) is NBA.com's official per-player efficiency metric
RAPTOR (FiveThirtyEight) uses on/off splits + RAPTOR_WAR to quantify real lineup impact
SHAP analysis in 2026 paper: player-level ELO derivatives are top-3 features across all models
Ablation study: removing player-level features degrades both discrimination AND calibration

Key insight from 2026 MDPI paper: player-level features improve BOTH discrimination AND calibration
Expected: most impactful on early-season games and games with recent trades/injuries
